Apple today released the first iOS 27.2 beta, which is a surprise given that a 27.1 version was never released. In addition to a brand new Health app, iOS 27.2 beta 1 also expands Siri AI support to five new languages.

Siri AI gains French, Japanese, Spanish and more in iOS 27.2 beta 1

Siri AI launched with iOS 27 this week only on devices set to English.

Apple promised more languages would be supported soon, and if you're running the developer beta, that wait has indeed been very short.

iOS 27.2 beta 1 is out today, and Siri AI now supports the following new languages:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

Given that this week's release only supports English, this is a major language expansion.

However, now with the developer beta of iOS 27.2, as long as your device is set to English, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese or Spanish, you can use the more powerful Siri AI.

Have you tried Siri AI in iOS 27 yet? How has your experience been? Share with us in the comments.
